cli.global_help.debug.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.debug.note: Inherited --debug flag enables verbose diagnostics; flag token remains in argparse.

cli.global_help.agent.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.agent.note: Inherited --agent/--agent-name chooses the legacy named-agent model, not an exec role. Preserve --train and exec --profile tokens and the separate persisted-session distinction.

cli.global_help.train.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.train.note: Inherited --train chooses legacy history/autosave storage. Ordinary sessions still persist; --resume takes precedence. Preserve the flag token.

cli.global_help.description.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.description.note: Top-level CLI paragraph. Preserve leading/trailing newlines and paragraph whitespace, hosting/model brand names, and literal ~/.local-operator/config.yml path; translate explanatory prose, not executable/config identifiers.

cli.global_help.resume.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.resume.note: Root --resume accepts a session id or no id for latest; preserve Ctrl+C twice, ~/.local-operator/sessions and --resume technical tokens.

cli.global_help.version.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.version.note: Root --version prints the version and exits; the actual v-prefixed version string remains code-owned.

cli.global_help.hosting.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.hosting.note: Root --hosting overview lists literal provider choices. Preserve their spellings and the original display order, even where parser-choice ordering differs.

cli.global_help.model.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.model.note: Root --model examples are literal model IDs/provider routes. Preserve every ID and punctuation; omitted model uses the provider suggestion.

cli.global_help.run_in.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.run_in.note: Root --run-in requires a valid working directory. Preserve the exact double space before Must for byte fidelity.

cli.global_help.yolo.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.yolo.note: Shared root/propagated --yolo auto-approves tool tiers without prompts. This is the ordinary promise, separate from conditional peer-create consent.

cli.global_help.no_tui.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.no_tui.note: Root --no-tui chooses the plain headless REPL instead of the full-screen TUI; preserve those interface abbreviations.

cli.global_help.tui.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.tui.note: Root --tui forces full-screen mode even for non-tty stdout and reports failure if that is impossible; preserve tty/stdout technical terms.

cli.global_help.yolo_conditional.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.yolo_conditional.note: Propagated --yolo on a grant-gated peer-create verb is conditional on the target granting the literal unattended capability; preserve this safety distinction and capability token.

cli.global_help.propagated_resume.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.propagated_resume.note: Propagated --resume help is deliberately shorter than root help; omitted id selects the most recent session.

cli.global_help.propagated_hosting.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.propagated_hosting.note: Propagated --hosting help lists literal example provider IDs; preserve anthropic/openai/openrouter spellings.

cli.global_help.propagated_model.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.propagated_model.note: Propagated --model selects the model for this run, not the legacy agent.

cli.global_help.propagated_run_in.tone: operator-facing, concise, preserves technical identifiers and safety distinctions
cli.global_help.propagated_run_in.note: Propagated --run-in changes the operator working directory; flag spelling stays in code.
